                The Jack Russell Terrier Network of Northern California is the 
                largest Jack Russell club in the western states. The 
                JRTNNC 
                sponsors active events 
                and rescue for Jack Russell 
                Terrier enthusiasts in the western states and Canada.
       Our
Rescue Service 
                saves countless terriers every year from shelters and homes where 
                they can no longer be kept. The club newsletter 
                is published four times a year and gives each member information 
                on everything from recent trial results to the latest litters.
Join Us!
 
                     Please 
                contact the JRTNNC 
                with questions you may have about this great little terrier with 
                unique characteristics and a working heritage.

                The Jack Russell Terrier Network of Northern California is the 

                largest Jack Russell club in the western states. The JRTNNC 

                sponsors active events 

                and rescue for Jack 

                Russell Terrier enthusiasts in the western states and Canada.
       Our
Rescue Service 

                saves countless terriers every year from shelters and homes where 

                they can no longer be kept. The club newsletter 

                is published four times a year and gives each member information 

                on everything from recent trial results to the latest litters.

                contact the JRTNNC 

                with questions you may have about this great little terrier with 

                unique characteristics and a working heritage.

                  The Jack Russell Terrier Network of Northern California is the 
                  largest Jack Russell club in the western states. The 
                  JRTNNC 
                  sponsors active events 
                  and rescue for Jack 
                  Russell Terrier enthusiasts in the western states and Canada.

       Our
Rescue Service 
                saves countless terriers every year from shelters and homes where 
                they can no longer be kept. The club newsletter 
                is published four times a year and gives each member information 
                on everything from recent trial results to the latest litters.
Join Us!
 
                     Please 
                contact the JRTNNC 
                with questions you may have about this great little terrier with 
                unique characteristics and a working heritage.
